title: Bagel's Horse Flutes
description: Using a goat horn will teleport the last horse you rode to you.
body:
Simply play any goat horn to teleport the last horse you rode to you.

Works with all horses that have a horse armor slot.

Be careful when summoning your horse on a tight ledge in case you accidentally push it off.

Supports Multiplayer.

Made for Java 1.21.6.
